e02-ana-washes-her-hands-before-dinner-r.observed_description: Ana, in the sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans, stands at the white-cabinet sink under the dusk-blue window with the black faucet, turned toward the camera with a relaxed smile, washing soapy hands under running water; in front of her, low in the middle of the photo, the wooden table holds an untouched plate of chicken, rice and vegetables, a fork on a folded napkin and a glass of water, with an empty chair. Reads as washing her hands before dinner at 180 px in the full 3:2 frame.
e02-ana-washes-her-hands-before-dinner-r.crop_limit: The centered 4:5 crop keeps her face and the waiting plate but cuts her soapy hands at the right edge, so the 1.3 brief marks this item four_card false: it appears only in one-, two- and three-picture cards and full 3:2 frames, never in a 2x2 grid.
